examples.en: I am doing a master's degree in design, and I really like it.

examples.target: 聽落好有要求。你最鍾意邊個科目？
examples.en: That sounds demanding. Which subject is your favorite?

examples.target: 我最鍾意研究方法，雖然考試好難。
examples.en: My favorite subject is research methods, although the exams are difficult.

examples.target: 明年，如果我趕得切所有截止日期，同埋合格嘅話。
examples.en: Next year, if I meet every deadline and pass my courses.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.en: So, what are you studying at the moment?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我讀緊設計碩士學位，我好鍾意。
dialogue.en: I am doing a master's degree in design, and I really like it.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: 聽落好有要求。你最鍾意邊個科目？
dialogue.en: That sounds demanding. Which subject is your favorite?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我最鍾意研究方法，雖然考試好難。
dialogue.en: My favorite subject is research methods, although the exams are difficult.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 明年，如果我趕得切所有截止日期，同埋合格嘅話。
dialogue.en: Next year, if I meet every deadline and pass my courses.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: 你係全職讀書定係一邊做嘢一邊讀？
dialogue.en: Do you work or study full time?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 全職。我有獎學金，所以可以專心讀書。
dialogue.en: Full time. I have a scholarship, so I can focus on my studies.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: 你知唔知畢業之後想做啲咩？
dialogue.en: Do you already know what you want to do afterwards?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 都未完全知，不過我想喺一間科技公司做嘢。
dialogue.en: Not exactly, but I would like to work in a technology company.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: 係個好計劃。我相信你會搵到好嘅工作。
dialogue.en: That is a good plan. I am sure you will find something.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 多謝！讀書好辛苦，但係我學到好多嘢。
dialogue.en: Thanks! Studying is hard, but I am learning a lot.
